notes: Added stable recording aliases to the existing normalized Yellowdawg MusicVerse schema instead of creating a competing catalog.
Added and verified the protected musicverse_import_catalog_v1 RPC for repeat-safe catalog synchronization.
Crazy Covers now resolves through permanent crazy-cover-#### aliases even when a recording is shared with an album track or another module.
The current GitHub catalog snapshot was synchronized to Yellowdawg: 111 albums, 340 album tracks, 632 Crazy Covers, 78 SoundTrail recordings, and 7 instruments.
A second full synchronization of the identical snapshot produced no row-count changes, verifying repeat-safe behavior on the real catalog.
Catalog audit now compares permanent Crazy Covers IDs as well as album and SoundTrail IDs.
